assumptions: Finite rigid translations from authored CAD-mm offsets to zero; previous instances stay at their final poses and future instances are absent, following the existing ordered guide player.
Offsets are presentation trajectories unless the producer separately authors manufacturing intent. A zero-offset operation checks its final pose only; it establishes no insertion path.
Source CAD-to-mesh correspondence is declared by the exporter which emitted both from the same shapes. Hashes verify the captured inputs, not a mathematical equivalence of BREP and tessellation.

The existing conservative-advancement sweep samples near obstacles; thinner crossings between samples can be missed. Touching is allowed, without tolerance stack, deformation, shrink, hands or fixtures.

Fastener engagement, tools, retention, internal assembly of compound instances, gravity and support stability are not checked. Use the separate fastener and qualified-subassembly gates where applicable.
Input/frame preflight only: no insertion pair was evaluated; this is not a clearance verdict.
